{{Current events|year=2019|month=04|day=15|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[AT&T|AT&T Inc.]] sells its 10% stake in [[Hulu]] to Hulu LLC for $1.43 billion. [https://variety.com/2019/digital/news/hulu-acquires-att-stake-1-43-billion-1203190132/ (Variety)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Notre-Dame de Paris fire]]
**A fire breaks out at the [[Notre-Dame de Paris]] cathedral in [[Paris]], resulting in the collapse of its roof and [[spire]] and considerable damage to the building's interior. [https://www.ajc.com/news/national/fire-reported-paris-notre-dame-cathedral/ukKe051QWt0d21wFgEhWbP/ (AJC)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47941794 (BBC)]
*The [[Al-Aqsa Mosque]] in Jerusalem caught fire. [https://www.newsweek.com/notre-dame-fire-aqsa-mosque-1397259 (''Newsweek'')]
;Law and crime
*Four people are killed in a string of shootings in [[Penticton]], [[British Columbia]]. Police continue to have the downtown on lockdown as they deal with the situation. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/police-penticton-residents-stay-inside-serious-incident-1.5098815 (CBC News)]
;International relations 
*[[Inter-Korean summits]], [[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[President of South Korea|South Korean President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] says he is ready for a fourth summit with [[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]]. The [[2019 inter-Korean summit]] will be held in the capital of South Korea, Seoul. [http://time.com/5570629/south-north-korea-summit-moon-kim/ (Time)] [https://www.sfgate.com/news/world/amp/South-Korean-president-calls-for-4th-summit-with-13767486.php (SFGate)]
